source_file: ATE - Code SAS 9 with table promotion to CAS.sas
notes: The two PROC SQL steps that build annee_trimestre (deriving order year via year() and quarter via qtr()) and commandes_trim (SUM of quantity and retail price GROUP BY customer/year/quarter), kept as written. The external BASE library ETUDE.ORDERS is replaced by an 8-row inline mock in autoexec.sas with the same columns and types; a PROC PRINT shows the aggregated result.
